name: Geneva-tail knuckle on the pin knee: link 2's rear tail turns K through a one-tooth drive, so q2's encoder determines K (3 active, no K sensor)
family: redundant 4R with a determined spare (cam-slaved knuckle)
verdict: NOT a contender at 3 active: the honest tail metal costs 10-42 points. Best 28.66 fast near-touch (score 89.6; plain 28.66; reach 0.713, in-band 0.874, contact 0.040), with the law alone 18.88 at the same seats and 14.34 at LB1, which reproduces the judge's 13.79-14.34. H1 (verified, 3 active) stays the leader of the class. The exact 3-D one-tooth law itself is sound: with a Geneva entry (closest approach 4-8 deg of q2 after the onset), dK reaches 56 deg inside a 45-deg pressure angle, the rate stays <= 1.3, and there is no lift-off.
limiter: The rigid tail's sweep. It turns with link 2 about u2 through J2's whole range. Its height is the max over every pose kept of (a) the skin under the tip; one pose (plane -30, elev 60) alone needs 92 mm from GH against hub K at 55-60, so the roller sits 25-32 mm over the skin. Also (b) link 1b, which it crosses: the surface-of-revolution stacking rule puts it >= 4 mm over link 1b everywhere. And (c) at the tip, K's cap (crown, cap + 4 mm) or link 1a's lug (beside). Tail in band 0.0-0.25 (median 20-32 mm), roller 0.04-0.10. A shorter bk2 shortens the tail (L_t = bk2 -+ d) but also squeezes K's range (bk1 + bk2 >= a1max + 5).
note: Model: kit-rule B (phys q2 stop, capK 6, pin knee, near-touch objective) with the stretched stop replaced by the exact spatial contact law. The flank half-plane passes through K's axis on link 1a, and the roller is on a small circle about u2. Per-t gates: monotone, rate <= 3.45, pressure angle <= 45, tooth extent, K stop B, and lift-off (self-motion slope). One tooth (no folded lobe). Tail strap LT 8 x 3, skin-fitted, in band. The roller boss O8 x 3 is sampled. Pairs: LT and roller vs hub 1 / K (cap) / hub 3 / L1a / L1b / knee / pad / E. Search: 4 hand checks + farm LHS 256 (bk1, bk2, a1max, smhi, smlo, d, psi_c) + 256 local perturbations of the top 8, half of them also moving the J1/J2/J3 seats. Convergence gate on 506 tries: gain over the 2nd half 0.55, over the last third 0.02, top-5 spread 0.55 (passes, but it is a 2-stage search, not CMA). Red team: (1) the TIP need is set by ONE workspace pose. Coupling it into the greedy pose drop gave 35.15 vs 30.72, so the shape choice is kept. (2) Local vs farm differ by 0.5 at the coarse best (30.72 vs 30.18). (3) r_law 70 mm is used in the law, and the real tip radius differs (rho/r effect < 0.5 deg). (4) K's stack flip is not applied to the link levels (L1a / L1b swap 3.15 mm at K, a wash to first order). (5) The roller axis must stay parallel to the flank, but the tail turns about u2 at 26-47 deg to uK, so a crowned roller (point contact) is needed. Frozen exact Bench(110,360): see the doc (running at report time). Fallback (lobe-rocker pushrod, kK <= 3.5) not built: the cost is the tail's sweep, and a rim lobe + rocker + pushrod rides the same link-1b strip.
